summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 30 (Provider Uptime %, Demo Amount Presets, Method Filter). All three additive UI features verified end-to-end via Playwright against the production preview URL as Super Admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Uptime counter is session-scoped (in-memory cardHealth state) and resets on remount/reload — expected per spec, but users may find '100% · 1/1' misleading right after login; consider labeling it 'this session' more prominently (currently already shown as 'uptime (session)').
Demo-link dialog does not gate 'Generate demo link' on amount>0 explicitly (input has min=1); acceptable, but consider preventing zero/negative.
Payments table filter counts are computed client-side from currently loaded rows only — if pagination is added later, counts may become misleading.
seed_data_creation: Added a demo_upi (Sandbox) provider account to tenant 'Acme Commerce' during the Demo-link dialog test. If future tests need a tenant WITHOUT demo_upi to reach the wizard's demo-link dialog, disable/delete the demo_upi account on Acme or use a fresh tenant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Provider Uptime %: On /dashboard/providers, provider-uptime-{id} shows 'uptime (session)100%· 1/1' after first check and increments to 2/2 upon clicking provider-health-badge-{id}. Verified on both CapTest 3b91058e (demo_upi + mock) and Acme Commerce (mock only, then demo_upi added). Method Filter on /dashboard/payments: payment-method-filter shows chips payment-filter-all, payment-filter-upi (with count 6), payment-filter-card (with count 0); UPI filter shows 6 UPI rows, Card filter shows 'No CARD payments.' empty state, All restores 6 rows; all row badges match active filter. Demo Presets: opened wizard on Acme, selected wizard-provider-demo_upi, clicked through steps, wizard-save shows toast 'Provider account connected' and opens demo-link-dialog. Chips demo-link-preset-1/99/1500 correctly set demo-link-amount to 1/99/1500 respectively; demo-link-generate creates working /checkout/{token} URL.

detailed_verification.regression_notes: Payments table rendered 6 rows with Reference/Method/Provider Txn/Amount/Fee/Net/Risk/Status/Details/Refund columns — unchanged. Providers cards still show Healthy badge (click-to-recheck confirmed via counter increment). Non-demo provider (mock) was previously connected on Acme without a demo-link dialog — regression maintained.
